input.text: Complaints should be closed within 15 business days of the day they arrive, or within 30 business days when another department has to investigate. Acknowledge every written complaint within 2 business days.
sources: Complaints should be closed within 15 business days of the day they arrive, or within 30 business days when another department has to investigate.
Acknowledge every written complaint within 2 business days.

input.text: Limit fee waivers to two per account in each calendar year.
sources: Limit fee waivers to two per account in each calendar year.
Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date.

input.text: A branch manager can lower a loan rate by no more than 0.25% as an exception. A regional manager can approve a rate exception as large as 0.50%. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
sources: A branch manager can lower a loan rate by no more than 0.25% as an exception.
A regional manager can approve a rate exception as large as 0.50%.

input.text: The minimum opening deposit for a consumer checking account is $25, in most cases. Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements, in most cases.
sources: The minimum opening deposit for a consumer checking account is $25.
Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.

input.text: Retain closed account records for 7 years from the closing date. Retain closed account records for 5 years from the closing date. The records custodian must approve the destruction of any records in writing.
sources: Retain closed account records for 7 years from the closing date.
In Kansas branches, retain closed account records for 5 years from the closing date.
The records custodian must approve the destruction of any records in writing.
